name: Dr. Michelle Currier
bio: JD's most significant professor at SUNY Canton — taught Critical Issues in Criminal Justice (Fall 2020), Profiling and Behavioral Criminology (Spring 2022), and two sex offender courses (Fall 2022). Labeled JD "Person X" during the Profiling course — a designation for individuals who don't fit behavioral consistency models cleanly. Highly analytical, personally critical of law enforcement. Her ex-husband Herb Currier trained JD at the hospital; her son Dustin Currier was an instructor at JD's police academy. Served as a professional reference multiple times.
